name: Island Coin
subtitle: Fixed-supply community token
description: Example 1 — a fixed-supply ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit. No mint entry point exists after launch.
long_description: A community point / game currency base shape. The whole supply is minted once to the recipient at deployment; no mint path exists afterwards, so inflation risk is removed by construction. Includes EIP-2612 permit so users can approve with a signature instead of a transaction. Copy contracts/src/token/FixedSupplyToken.sol, deploy with your name/symbol/supply/recipient, and fill this manifest with real addresses before publishing.
